class.description: GameplayRuleEditorInspectorPlugin — Phase 4 Editor Inspector plugin for GameplayRule. Responsibilities: 1. Header Specificity & Scope Badge Pill: Displays computed CSS-like specificity (e.g., [0, 1, 1] -> 110), scope (:host, *, :host,*), cascade @layer, and a live "Matches N entities in current scene (Select)" button. 2. Smart Selector Autocomplete Pickers: - target_class: Dropdown of Game, GameEntity, GameBoard, GameAgent, GamePiece, GameAgentAction, GamePieceAction, GameInteraction, GameProperty. - target_title_or_group: Dropdown populated from active scene GameEntity titles, Godot Node groups, and competes_with_groups tags. - target_property: Dropdown populated from reflected ClassDB properties on target_class plus active scene GameProperty titles (including :max_value, :min_value, :locked). Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
